hypothesis.customerProblem: Small specialty food suppliers may struggle to find receiving and shipping lot references during traceability inquiries.
hypothesis.buyerTrigger: A distributor receives or releases a food lot and must coordinate supporting references.
hypothesis.expensiveFailure: Missing lot handoff references can delay internal reviews during an inventory or delivery discrepancy.
hypothesis.discoveryQuestion: How does the distribution team locate linked receiving and shipping documents for a lot today?
hypothesis.differentiator: Connect internal lot reference, receiving handoff, shipping handoff and traceability plan review in one dated checklist.

recipe.title: Food Lot Transfer Desk
recipe.buyer: Small specialty food distributors handling business-to-business shipments
recipe.outcome: Track recorded lot, receipt and shipment references for internal handoff review; not regulatory certification.
